Thursday, 16 August, 2012/25th Sravana,  1934 (Saka)

MR CHAIRMAN in the Chair
OBITUARY REFERENCE
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon. Members, 1 refer with profound sorrow to the
passing away of Shri Vilasrao Dagadojirao Deshmukh, Minister without portfolio and
a sitting Member of this House, on the 14th of August 2012 at the age of 67 years.
Born in Babhalgaon, in Latur District of Maharashtra, in May 1945, Shri
Deshmukh had his education at Garware College, Pune University and ILS Law
College, Pune.
An agriculturist, Shri Vilasrao Deshmukh served as Sarpanch of Babhalgaon
Village Panchayat, and as Deputy Chairman of Latur Taluka Panchayat Samiti
between 1974 and 1979. He also served as Director of the Latur Agriculture
Marketing Committee in 1976, the Osmanabad District Centre Cooperative Bank and
the Maharashtra State Cooperative Bank in 1979. He played an instrumental role for
the empowerment of the Zila Panchayats and strengthening of the Panchayati Raj
system.
Shri Deshmukh started his legislative career as a Member of the Maharashtra
Legislative Assembly in 1980. He was a Member of that Assembly from 1980 to 1995,
and again from 1999 to 2009.
He served as Minister of State in the Government of Maharashtra holding
portfolios of the Department of Rural Development, Home, General Administration,
Agriculture, Transport, Education, Technical Education, Sports and Youth Affairs,
and Information and Publicity between 1982 and 1985.
He also served as Minister of Rural Development, Agriculture, Cooperation,

Dairy Development and Fisheries, Public Works, Industries, Education and Technical
Education, Sports and Youth Welfare, Cooperation, Transport, Parliamentary Affairs
in the Government of Maharashtra between 1986 and 1995.
He served as Chief Minister of Maharashtra for two terms from October 1999
to January 2003 and again from November 2004 to December 2008. As Chief Minister,
he initiated a number of programmes to revolutionise urban infrastructure of Mumbai
City, modernising education, agriculture and rural infrastructure, as well as attracting
global investors to invest in Indian industry .
Shri Vilasrao Dagadojirao Deshmukh represented the S tate of Maharashtra in
this House for two terms, from August 2009 to April 2012 and again from April 2012
till his sad demise. He served as Minister of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises
from May 2009 to January 2011; as Minister of Rural Development and Panchayati
Raj from January 201 1 to July 201 1; and as Minister of Science and Technology,
Earth Sciences and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises from July 2011 to the 10th
of August 2012; and Minister without portfolio from the 1 1th of August 2012 till his
sad demise.
In the passing away of Shri Vilasrao Dagadojirao Deshmukh, the country has
lost an able administrator and a distinguished parliamentarian.
We deeply mourn the passing away of Shri Vilasrao Dagadojirao Deshmukh.
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a mark of
respect to the memory of the departed.
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute)
MR. CHAIRMAN: Secretary-General will convey to the members of the
bereaved family our sense of profound sorrow and deep sympathy .
As a mark of respect to the memory of Shri Vilasrao Dagadojirao Deshmukh,
sitting Member , the House stands adjourned till 1 1.00 a.m. on Friday , 17th August,
2012.
The House then adjourned at six minutes past eleven of the clock till
eleven of the clock on Friday 17th August, 2012.
